content: Claude Code compaction behavior (community-documented, MEDIUM confidence): auto-compact triggers near 92-95% context capacity, summarizes conversation into a continuation summary passed to a fresh context; /compact [instructions] manual trigger; preserves file paths/recent snippets/task state/todos; known lossy failure modes (mid-task instruction loss) drive user workarounds. ass-guard's own corpus scan (docs/compaction-decision.md) found NO auto-compact in the zcode corpus — zcode manages context via rolling last-64-message window + cache_control on every system block; that doc routes cache_control emission as a post-adoption gap.
